summary: Frontend-only testing of static Bakaboiz launcher at /nocturne-cleaned.html. Verified all 6 items in the review request: (1) dither background visible & not black, (2) Request Game button visibility scoped to sussy tab, (3) Request Game webhook submit + validation, (4) Report a problem button always visible + webhook submit + validation, (5) empty-submit validation for both modals, (6) Ambient effects Settings toggle disables/enables the dither canvas. Desktop 1920x800 and mobile 390x844 both sanity-checked. All checks PASSED.

dither_background.avg_brightness_at_(80-160,100-180): 204/255 (well above 30 threshold - bright purple/lilac dither visible)

request_game_visibility.result: PASS - scoped correctly to sussy only

ambient_effects_toggle.note: Toggle takes effect after clicking Save (setSave), not immediately on switch click. This matches source code (window.NFDither.setEnabled invoked on save).

critical_code_review_comments: Static single-file HTML (~835 lines) is acceptable size. Body bg transparent + html bg dark is the correct fix for the reported black-cover bug.
Ambient effects toggle applies only on Save. If instant preview is desired, invoke NFDither.setEnabled(on) inside the #setFx click handler too. Not a bug, but a UX enhancement.
Discord webhook URLs (REQ_WEBHOOK, REPORT_WEBHOOK) are hardcoded in client-side JS and thus publicly exposed — anyone can spam them. Consider proxying through a backend or rate-limiting client-side.
loadLibrary() uses classList.toggle('show', lib==='sussy') which relies on CSS .show display rule; verified working.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static HTML page at /nocturne-cleaned.html. Dismiss the 'Welcome to Bakaboiz' setup modal by clicking 'Save & continue' before interacting. Default library is Lumin which usually falls back to gnmath with a toast (expected). Request Game button is only visible on sussybakabois library tab. Ambient effects toggle in Settings only applies after clicking Save button (#setSave). Discord webhooks are live — each webhook test posts a real message.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found in this iteration. Original 'black background blocking dither' bug already fixed by making body background transparent (verified: bodyBg=rgba(0,0,0,0), htmlBg=rgb(5,6,13), canvas at z=-3 with brightness 204/255 sampled at empty body area).
